notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Preparing for an update to the free Supporter DLC, today's update also brings a few small improvements.

Features


 The new command !heroxp displays the current level as well as the required experience to the next level.


Bugfixes


 Rapidly consecutive effects swallowed the second effect.
 At the beginning of an effect, the last frame of the previous effect flashed.
 The Battle Royale contdown could get stuck in an endless loop.

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
The winter update comes with some usability improvements and enhancements. In addition, a few bugs were discovered and fixed.

Features:


 A tutorial video to help with the setup has been linked directly.
 A graphics package is now available for download. This includes icons for the rewards and backgrounds.
 Cards can now be disabled.
 The available player cards are displayed in the respective tab under the mobs.
 Channel reward redemptions can now be paused.
 New !-commands enable the streamer and his mods to start fights. This can be used to trigger fights via stream deck, for example.
 The Moder Groats and the Abyss Creeper have been added to the mob cards.
 The supporter mod has been extended by the card "Hungry Luckydrops".


Bugs:


 The Prestige level is now preserved when someone has a player card that is removed from the mods.
 Poison no longer attacks the Ultimate Defense.
 The Despair ability, which banishes a character, no longer delays the next action by one turn.
 Visual repetition of identical global effects now works.

notes.title: Prestige Promotion Update
notes.notes:
The big update brings two features that will immerse your community in deeper battlecards: Battles via channel points and prestige level promotion.

Features:


 Community Battles can be started via channel points.
 Battle Royale Matches (with/without clones) can be started via channel points.
 The level limit has been unlocked to the top. Beyond level 15 no stats will be increased. The color of the reached level changes until level 150 (mythic).
 Respecs can be triggered via channel points through prestige levels. From level 15 upwards, the Prestige Level Promotion can be triggered and the player receives a new random level 1 character in addition to the Prestige Level Badge.

notes.title: Improvements Update
notes.notes:
Today's update contains some (graphical) improvements and bugfixes.

Improvements

 Active buffs are represented by graphics.
 The character level is now displayed.
 Unavailable actions are better marked.
 Battle Royale AI improved.
 Clones and their masters no longer attack each other in the first half of a Battle Royale.


Bug fixes

 A KO in Battle Royale no longer reduces health points in the next Community Battle.
 A hero defeated by Thorn Aura could be attacked again.

notes.title: Battle Royale Game Mode Release
notes.notes:
Stream Battlecards gets a Battle Royale mode. In addition to the classic Community Battles, your viewers can now compete against each other and earn a "Card Royale". Battle Royale battles have a higher pace because they run fully automated and can therefore be optimally live-commented. Every player competes with his character and his current level in Battle Royale. The optional clone mode adds a level 1 clone of each player's character and thus increases the chances of victory - but be careful, the clone can also turn against you!

The update also brings the following bugfixes:

Disconnections between control panel and stream overlay fixed.
The red "defeat" message now has its own display text.

notes.title: Internationalisation and Modding Update
notes.notes:
Stream Battlecards now recognizes the language of the browser the control panel is running in. German and English are the currently supported languages. The modding system has also been extended to allow other languages to be added. The translations must be created in the default structure under the two-character language code.

In addition, the modding system now supports the modification of individual values of existing configurations. For example, overwrite the attack of a mob in your mod by specifying only its key with the attack value.

With the Bone King a new enduring mob comes into the game.
